# IncorrectRandomRange

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" />

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `IncorrectRandomRangeInspection`

`rand()`, `mt_rand()` and `random_int()` expect `(min, max)`. Passing a
minimum greater than the maximum is an error (`random_int()` throws,
`mt_rand()` warns/returns false on older versions, `rand()` silently swaps).
Flag calls whose bounds are known numbers in the wrong order.

## Example

```php{10,12,14,15,16,18,20,21}
<?php
define('DICE_FACES', 6);

class Lottery { const LOW = 1; const HIGH = 49; }

function roll($bonus = 10)
{
    $floor = 100;
    return [
        mt_rand(9, 3),
        mt_rand(3, 9),
        rand(DICE_FACES, 1),
        rand(1, DICE_FACES),
        random_int(Lottery::HIGH, Lottery::LOW),
        \random_int($floor, -1),
        random_int($bonus, 0),
        random_int(0, PHP_INT_MAX),
        random_int(0, PHP_INT_MIN),
        random_int(7, 7),
        random_int(0x10, 1),
        mt_rand(2.5, 1),
        random_int(5, count([1])),
    ];
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 10: Minimum is greater than maximum in this random range.</li>
<li>line 12: Minimum is greater than maximum in this random range.</li>
<li>line 14: Minimum is greater than maximum in this random range.</li>
<li>line 15: Minimum is greater than maximum in this random range.</li>
<li>line 16: Minimum is greater than maximum in this random range.</li>
<li>line 18: Minimum is greater than maximum in this random range.</li>
<li>line 20: Minimum is greater than maximum in this random range.</li>
<li>line 21: Minimum is greater than maximum in this random range.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "IncorrectRandomRange": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore IncorrectRandomRange

/**
 * @noinspection IncorrectRandomRangeInspection
 */
```
